TABLE.NAME: local_a11y_stats
TABLE.COMMENT: Aggregated, anonymous usage counters per accessibility option (D47) - one row per option id. No userid, courseid, sessionid, IP or per-event timestamp: nothing here can be used to reconstruct an individual's behaviour.

FIELD.NAME: featureid
FIELD.COMMENT: Accessibility option id, e.g. readableFont - matches classes/options.php ids.

FIELD.NAME: counter
FIELD.COMMENT: Total number of times this option was activated site-wide.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of the last increment for this row.

TABLE.NAME: local_a11y_stats_daily
TABLE.COMMENT: Aggregated, anonymous daily usage counters per accessibility option, added for the usage-trend chart on admin/stats.php. One row per (featureid, day) pair - same non-personal-data shape as local_a11y_stats (see its own comment), just bucketed by day instead of a single running total. No userid, courseid, sessionid or IP column: nothing here can be used to reconstruct an individual's behaviour.

FIELD.NAME: featureid
FIELD.COMMENT: Accessibility option id, e.g. readableFont - matches classes/options.php ids.

FIELD.NAME: day
FIELD.COMMENT: UTC calendar day this row counts, as a YYYYMMDD integer (e.g. 20260912) - see classes/stats.php::day_bucket().

FIELD.NAME: counter
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of times this option was activated site-wide on this day.

TABLE.NAME: local_a11y_stats_bytype
TABLE.COMMENT: Aggregated, anonymous usage counters per accessibility option, broken down by account type (Moodle's built-in Guest account vs. a real authenticated account), added for the 'activations by user type' chart on admin/stats.php. One row per (featureid, guest) pair - at most 2 rows per option. `guest` is a 0/1 role flag decided once per request (isguestuser()), never a specific user id: this cannot be used to single out which guest session or which authenticated account triggered any activation, only how many came from each of the two groups in total. No userid, courseid, sessionid or IP column: nothing here can be used to reconstruct an individual's behaviour.

FIELD.NAME: featureid
FIELD.COMMENT: Accessibility option id, e.g. readableFont - matches classes/options.php ids.

FIELD.NAME: guest
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if this row counts activations from Moodle's Guest account, 0 for real authenticated accounts.

FIELD.NAME: counter
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of times this option was activated site-wide by this account type.
